notes.title: Updated instructions on Jan. 26, 2022
notes.content:
Hi everybody, we've had a lot of updates to the game this time.

1. We changed the lighting atmosphere of the whole scene, and we turned up the brightness of the lamp on the left hand. 
2. We've updated the language support for the game, we added German, Italian, Spanish and Japanese now.

We look forward to welcoming more VR enthusiasts to play our game. Thank you so much!

notes.title: Update Notification!!
notes.content:
Hi everybody,

It's been a week since Lost in Abyss was released. We are very pleased to have received a lot of feedback from our players. About the problems that you are having during the game, We have made fixes and optimizations accordingly. As follows:

1. Improved part of the dubbing and screen effects.

2. Several clues have been added.

3. Fixed some bugs (such as: open drawers or cupboards).


Thank you for your understanding and hope for your continued support .

Thank you very much!!

notes.title: Lost in Abyss official release. The first week 75% off.
notes.content:
To all players:

First of all, thank you for your support. Sorry to keep you waiting for a long time.

Lost in Abyss official release on Nov.11,2021. The first week 75% off. Welcome to try it right away.

Lost in Abyss is a VR horror puzzle game from the perspective OF the first person. Landen was dying in the ICU ward and gradually came to life... What exactly had he been through before? When everything began to become clear, all the mysteries were slowly solved.

During the game, if you have any questions, please contact us at any time. Thank you very much for your support and help to the game.

Our Discord channel: https://discord.gg/fFe7uWwY6B
Our Email add: lostinabyss@ugmax.cn

notes.title: Game rename announcement
notes.content:
Hi everybody,

From now on, the English name of the game is changed to [b]Lost in Abyss[/b]. The original game and player's play data content remains unchanged. Thank you for your support. Please look forward to the official version of our game. 

Thanks a lot!
